content.chronicleTemplate.resource_disco: A {{resourceName}} deposit was discovered near {{settlementName}} in {{regionName}}.

content.chronicleTemplate.company_founde: {{companyName}} was founded in {{settlementName}}, entering the {{sector}} sector.

content.eventType.company_closed.name: Company Closed
content.eventType.shortage_started.name: Shortage Started
content.chronicleTemplate.shortage_start: A shortage of {{goodName}} began in {{settlementName}}, affecting an estimated {{affectedPopulation}} residents.
content.eventType.shortage_resolved.name: Shortage Resolved
content.chronicleTemplate.shortage_resol: The shortage of {{goodName}} in {{settlementName}} ended after {{durationTicks}} months, resolved through {{resolutionMechanism}}.
content.eventType.migration_wave.name: Migration Wave

content.chronicleTemplate.settlement_sta: {{settlementName}} advanced from {{oldStage}} to {{newStage}} after a period of {{mainDriver}}.
content.chronicleTemplate.discovery_occu: {{discoveryName}} was discovered in {{regionName}}, the first such discovery in {{noveltyScope}}.
content.chronicleTemplate.technology_ado: {{methodName}} spread across {{regionName}}, adopted by an estimated {{adoptionPercent}}% of relevant producers.
content.chronicleTemplate.technology_tie: Technologies of tier {{tier}} became available in {{regionName}}, the first such step in {{noveltyScope}}.
content.chronicleTemplate.trade_route_em: A sustained trade route formed between {{originName}} and {{destinationName}}, carrying {{primaryGood}}.
content.eventType.regional_boom.name: Regional Boom
content.chronicleTemplate.regional_boom_: {{regionName}} experienced a sustained economic boom, driven by {{primaryCause}}, with production up about {{growthPercent}}%.
content.eventType.regional_bust.name: Regional Bust
